model: A viewport query used to test every loaded restaurant. Restaurants now sit in 0.05 degree cells. A window tests only the cells it touches, then checks those restaurants against the exact bounds. A window wider than the list still scans the whole list. The same list reuses the cell index.
fixture: 1000 restaurants on a 0.1 degree lattice from latitude 33 and longitude 126. Window south 37.45, north 37.55, west 126.95, east 127.05.

noise.rule: The fixture is uniform, not the live Seoul distribution. A city viewport examines every restaurant in the touched cells, which is more than 2 when many restaurants share a neighborhood. Not a field trace.
